answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 5 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the lotus count is verified against the quartz text itself, the whisper audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 176 aliases as a result means producing 176 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
